text: かいパンやろうの　おめい　へんじょう　ならず…

structure.jp: おめい　へんじょう　ならず…
structure.en: clearing of his name does not come to pass...

patterns.name: 〜ず
patterns.explanation: ず is an old, written-style way of saying 'not', used instead of ない. Here it gives a headline feel. ならず = 'does not come about', so 'fails'.
